args.description: Source evaluation for Edward Tallman KPQ5-V9F
args.prompt:
Examine all sources attached to Edward Tallman, FamilySearch person ID KPQ5-V9F. For each source, read the index entry and, where possible, the original image.

Then produce a correlation table with:
- One row per event conclusion (birth date, birth place, christening, death date, death place, burial, marriage date, marriage place, etc.) and per relationship conclusion (each parent, each spouse, each child).
- Column 1: The conclusion currently recorded on the FamilySearch profile (fact type + value).
- Subsequent columns: What each cited source actually says for that fact (by source label/title). Use "—" when the source does not address that fact, and flag discrepancies with a note like "[CONFLICT]".

After the table, add an annotation section covering:
1. Any conflicting evidence between sources.
2. Patterns in consistent evidence (e.g., multiple independent sources agreeing).
3. Any conclusions that have no supporting evidence or only one weak source.
4. Overall assessment of the profile's source support.

Do not write to research.json — this is a read-only audit delivered as a report to the researcher. Use the project path /project if a project exists there, otherwise operate without one.

agent_returns.text:
**SOURCES ON: Edward Tallman (KPQ5-V9F): 27 attached and readable, 1 unreadable, 1 external link unchecked. 4 user-actionable findings.**

No project exists at `/project`, so nothing was logged and nothing was written. I cannot open images, so "original image" checks are listed as re-read pointers only.

**Source key** (label, title as attached, record ID)

- **[A]** Edward, "Vermont, Vital Records, 1760-1954", death 1913: 2V7M-JMY
- **[B]** Edward Tallman, "Vermont, Vital Records, 1760-2008", death 1913: KN9R-2KJ
- **[C]** Edward Mollman, "Vermont, Deaths and Burials, 1871-1965", death 1913: F8R4-RYM
- **[D]** Edward Tallman, "Vermont, Town Clerk, Vital and Town Records, 1732-2005", death 1913: QPQ2-58BX
- **[E]** Edward Tallman, "Find a Grave Index": QVKW-7BXX
- **[F]** Tombstone of Edward Tallman (memory 7349489, transcribed text only)
- **[G]** Edward Tollman, "United States, Census, 1850" (Joseph Tollman household): MCTB-KBM
- **[H]** Edward Tallman, "New York, State Census, 1865": QVNJ-JDJD
- **[I]** Edward Tallman, "United States, Census, 1870" (Horace Stevens entry): M8N9-JJL
- **[J]** Edward Tollman, "New York, State Census, 1875": VT8T-XYW
- **[K]** Edward Tallman, "United States, Census, 1880": MZ83-SG1
- **[L]** Edward Tallman, "United States, Census, 1910" (Chas H Derby household): M5W8-LDP
- **[M]** Vermont marriage of Fannie Tolman and N H Bissonette, 4 Jun 1890 (three records): XFXS-8D3, QPQV-662T, QPQX-DRDD
- **[N]** Vermont marriage of Blanche Tolman and Alfred Bissonette, 4 Jan 1893 (three records): QPQG-F2GF, QPQL-F9N3, XFXS-886
- **[O]** Vermont marriage of Theodore B. Tallman and Julia Laramy, 26 Feb 1895: XF4D-B9M
- **[P]** Vermont death of Helen L McIntosh, 19 Apr 1943 (three records): VNRV-QZJ, KFTK-Z6N, F8R7-NW1
- **[Q]** Vermont death of Fannie Tollman Bissonnette, 15 Jun 1948: KF5F-WMS
- **[R]** Vermont death of Orrin Tallman, 28 Sep 1930 (three records): KN9R-KC4, 2V7M-6QM, F8RW-X4N
- **[S]** Vermont record naming Edward as father of Orran Tollman, marriage 12 Nov 19.. : XFXS-8Y5

**Correlation table**

Each row gives the recorded conclusion, then what the sources say about it. A source that does not address the fact is left out of the row, not shown as "—", to keep the table readable.

| Conclusion on profile | What the cited sources say | Status |
|---|---|---|
| **Birth, 30 Nov 1838** | [E] 31 Jan 1839 [CONFLICT]. [F] Tombstone age "74 yrs. 6 mos. 16 dys." at death on 16 Aug 1913 implies birth 31 Jan 1839 [CONFLICT]. Age-derived ranges agree: [A] 1838–1839, [C] 1838–1839, [G] 1838–1839, [H] 1838–1839, [L] 1838–1839. Drift only, not a finding: [I] 1840–1841, [K] 1839–1840. | Exact-date sources conflict with the profile |
| **Birth place, Peru, Clinton, New York** | [B] "Peru" (agrees). [G], [I], [K], [L] "New York" (less precise, contained in the profile value). | Consistent |
| **Death, 16 Aug 1913** | [A], [B], [C], [D], [E], [F] all give 16 Aug 1913. | Agrees |
| **Death place, Burlington, Chittenden, Vermont** | [A] "Burlington". [B] and [C] "Burlington, Chittenden, Vermont". [D] "Vermont" (less precise). | Agrees |
| **Burial, Aug 1913, Whallon's Bay Cemetery, Essex** | [E] burial place "Essex, Essex, New York" (cemetery name not in the index entry). [F] does not name a cemetery. No source gives a burial date. | Place: one source. Date: unsourced |
| **Residence 1850, Au Sable, Clinton** | [G] Au Sable, Clinton, NY (agrees). | Agrees |
| **Residence 1870, Essex** | [I] Essex, NY (agrees). | Agrees |
| **Residence 1875, Essex** | [J] Essex, NY (agrees). | Agrees |
| **Residence 1880, Essex** | [K] Essex, ED 46 (agrees). The household lists no wife, though marital status is "Married". | Agrees |
| **Residence 1910, Perinton, Monroe** | [L] Perinton, Monroe, NY, widowed (agrees). | Agrees |
| **Marriage to Mary, about 1860, Essex** | No attached source gives a marriage date or place. [H] shows Edward and Mary as a household in 1865 (indirect). | No marriage evidence |
| **Marriage to Clarissa Wade, about 1866, Essex** | No attached source gives a marriage date or place. [S] and other Vermont records name Edward's wife as Clarissa or Clara Wade. | No marriage evidence |
| **Spouse, Mary (9VCF-GCG)** | [H] 1865 household, Mary Tallman age about 1841 (indirect). | One weak source |
| **Spouse, Clarissa Wade (KPQ5-HL4)** | [M] Edward Tolman with wife Clara Wade (1890 marriage, three records). [J] Clarissa in 1875 household. [R] and [S] name Edward with wife Clarissa or Clara Wade. | Strong |
| **Child, Mary (LZL8-9CJ), about 1860–1863** | No attached source addresses this child. | No support |
| **Child, Caroline (9VCF-GCK), 1863–1864** | No attached source addresses this child. | No support |
| **Child, Lilly (9VCF-GC2), June 1865** | [H] 1865 household, Lilly listed as a child. | One source |
| **Child, Frances Minerva (KG12-K59), 13 Oct 1866** | [M] Edward Tolman as father of the bride. [Q] death 1948 with Edward M Tollman as father and birth 13 Oct 1866. [J] Frances M, [K] Fannie. | Strong |
| **Child, Helen Lucretia (2Z3X-MXH), 10 Jul 1868** | [P] death 1943 with Edward as father; the record's Helen has birth 10 Jul 1868. [I] Nellie, [J], [K]. | Strong |
| **Child, Phoebe Lenora (LHLT-TG7), 17 Mar 1870** | [I] Phebe, 1870. [J] Phebe L, 1875. [L] Phoebe E Derby, daughter of Edward Tallman, 1910. Not in the 1880 household (no conflict). | Strong |
| **Child, Blanche Elvina (LZLZ-1BK), 15 Jan 1873** | [N] Edward Tolman as father of the bride, 1893 (three records). [J] Blanch L, [K] Blanche. | Strong |
| **Child, Theodore Burt (LHD6-27G), 15 Sep 1874** | [O] Edward Tallman as father, 1895. [J] Theodore B, [K] Theodore. | Strong |
| **Child, Orrin Jerome (L4HT-HXS), 14 Oct 1877** | [R] death 1930 with Edward as father (three records; F8RW-X4N gives the surname as "...Allman"). [K] Orrin, 1878. [S] Edward as father of Orran. | Strong, surname garbled in one record |
| **Father, Joseph Tallman (KPQ5-V4H)** | [G] Joseph Tollman as head, Edward as member, 1850. [A] father "Jas Tallman". [B] father "Joo Tallman". [C] father "...Allman, Joseph". | Relationship agrees; first-name variants |
| **Mother, Jane (Hannah) Patterson (KPQ5-VFN)** | [G] Hannah Tollman as wife, b. about 1812 Canada. [A], [B], [C] mother "Jane Patterson". | Agrees |
| *Not on profile:* child Norah Tallman, b. 1870 | [K] lists Norah Tallman, b. 1870, in Edward's household. No tree record. | Omission, not a conflict |

**Annotation**

1. **Conflicting evidence.** The only real conflict is the birth date. The profile's 30 Nov 1838 is contradicted by [E] (31 Jan 1839) and by the tombstone's stated age [F]. Working from the transcribed text, 74 years, 6 months and 16 days before 16 Aug 1913 is 31 Jan 1839, the same day [E] gives. No attached source states 30 Nov 1838. The other disagreements (census birth years 1839–1841, "New York" against "Peru") are ordinary variance or precision differences, not findings. No source-against-source conflict remains beyond the surname and first-name variants below.

2. **Patterns in consistent evidence.** The death (16 Aug 1913, Burlington) is supported by six records. Parentage (Joseph Tallman and Jane Patterson) is supported by three or more Vermont records and the 1850 census. The marriage to Clarissa Wade appears in several independent Vermont records as a couple. Five of the six children with Clarissa are supported by several independent records (Frances, Helen, Phoebe, Blanche, Theodore, Orrin). The residences 1850–1910 run in a consistent geographic line (Au Sable, Essex, Perinton). No record in the set is about a different Edward. The Tolman, Tollman, and Mollman variants all share the same parents, spouse and death date.

3. **Conclusions with no or weak support.** The birth date has no supporting source at all; the only exact-date sources contradict it. Both marriages have no marriage record attached. The children Mary (1860) and Caroline (1863) have no attached source. Lilly rests on one 1865 census entry. Burial has a place from one memorial entry and no date. Mary as spouse rests on one household listing.

4. **Overall assessment.** The profile is well supported for death, parentage, the second marriage's spouse, and most children. It is weak for the first marriage, the two early children, and the marriage dates generally. The birth date is in genuine conflict with the only exact-date evidence. Four index errors (below) are fixable and do not undermine the identifications.

**Findings**

1. **Edward Tallman, "Vermont, Vital Records, 1760-1954" (2V7M-JMY, https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:2V7M-JMY) — indexing error or profile error, kind cannot be told from this profile alone.** Index birth range is 1838–1839, which is consistent with both values. The exact-date sources [E] and [F] say 31 Jan 1839, not 30 Nov 1838.
   Next: re-read the Vermont death register image for 1913 (image ark 3:1:3QS7-9979-F9ZZ) and look for an age or birth date field. Also look at the stone itself. Do not detach any source. Then decide whether the profile's birth date should change.

2. **Edward Mollman, "Vermont, Deaths and Burials, 1871-1965" (F8R4-RYM, https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:F8R4-RYM) — indexing error (surname).** The surname is indexed "Mollman" and the father "...Allman". The date, place, mother Jane Patterson and wife Clarissa Wade all fit Edward Tallman.
   Next: re-read the original death register (image ark 3:1:3QS7-L99P-5ZTX) and correct the surname on the index entry. Keep the source attached.

3. **Edward ...Allman, "Vermont, Deaths and Burials, 1871-1965" (F8RW-X4N, https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:F8RW-X4N) — indexing error (surname).** The surname on the principal (Orrin) and on the father is "...Allman". The rest of the record matches Edward and Clarissa Wade.
   Next: re-read the original register (image ark 3:1:3QS7-L99P-HTGD) and correct the surname. Keep the source attached.

4. **Edward Tallman, "Vermont, Vital Records, 1760-1954" (2V7M-JMY) and Edward Tallman, "Vermont, Vital Records, 1760-2008" (KN9R-2KJ) — indexing variants on the father's first name.** The father is indexed "Jas" in 2V7M-JMY and "Joo" in KN9R-2KJ. The mother (Jane Patterson), the death and the household agree with the other records.
   Next: re-read the original certificates (image ark 3:1:3QS7-9979-F9ZZ for 2V7M-JMY) and correct the father's given name on the index entries. Keep both sources attached.

No misattribution was found. No source needs detaching.

**Could not check**

- Edward Tallman funeral notice, newspapers.com clip (9J22-G6F): an external link with no readable record.
- Edward M Tollman, "Vermont, Vital Records, 1760-1954" (S8T1-4MC, record XF2X-BYV): the record read returned a fixture error. It is unchecked, not clean.
- Tombstone of Edward Tallman (memory 7349489): only its transcribed text was read. I cannot open the image.

**Impossible-date check:** not run. It needs a project that holds this person.

**FamilySearch's profile checklist** (suggestions, not errors, not counted above)

- COMPLETENESS: Two marriage dates are missing a month.
- VERIFIABILITY: Two marriages have no tagged sources. Five residences have no tagged sources.
- CONSISTENCY: Two flags, but neither names a source with a finding, so both are dropped.

**Context:** FamilySearch also stores internal identifiers that repeat across related profiles. That is how it tracks them and needs nothing from you (1 kind of storage artifact, omitted).

Here is the source-evaluation agent's full report on **Cornelius Driscoll (GJ72-9WD)**:

---

## Source Audit — 7 Sources Reviewed | 2 Actionable Findings | 1 Conflict Referred On

---

### ✅ Consistent with the Profile (no action needed)

- **Ireland, Catholic Parish Registers, 1655–1915** — Christening 12 March 1814, Skibbereen, supports the recorded birth year of 1814. ✔
- **Census of Canada, 1861** — Residence Sherbrooke 1861 agrees with the profile. ✔ *(Birth year indexed as 1816 is within normal census variation and not flagged.)*

---

### ⚠️ Finding 1 — Indexing Error (Action Required)

**Quebec, Vital and Church Records (Drouin Collection), 1621–1968**
The index records the marriage date as **9 June 1845**, but the profile shows **9 June 1849** at St. Patrick's, Sherbrooke. Everything else (names, place) matches.

> **Next step:** Open the original marriage register image and read the year. If the register says 1849, correct the index. If it says 1845, correct the profile date. Keep the source either way.

---

### ⚠️ Finding 2 — Cannot Classify Without Original Image

**Census of Canada East, 1851**
Indexed residence: **Melbourne, Canada East**; profile records residence in **Sherbrooke**. No age or other corroborating field is indexed, so it's unclear whether this is an index keying error or a genuine discrepancy.

> **Next step:** Re-read the original 1851 census page for this household. Do not detach.

---

### 🔀 Source-Against-Source Conflict — Refer to Conflict Resolution

Two death records disagree and should be routed to the **conflict-resolution** workflow:

| Source | Date Given | Type |
|---|---|---|
| Quebec, Civil Registration Deaths, 1867–1900 | 2 February **1885** | Death registration |
| Quebec, Catholic Parish Registers, 1621–1979 | April **1878** (burial 14 April 1878, St. Patrick's Cemetery) | Burial register |

The profile has **no Death fact**, so neither contradicts the profile directly — but they contradict each other. Once the conflict is resolved, the burial date of **14 April 1878** can be added to the profile from the parish register.

---

### 🔍 Could Not Check

- **St. Patrick's Cemetery headstone photograph** (contributor memory upload) — no indexed record behind it; not evaluable by tool.

---

### 📌 Tree Coherence Note

The place checker flagged that at least one place on the profile is not linked to a standard FamilySearch place. Worth reviewing the place fields for the marriage, residence, and/or burial.

Here is what the source-evaluation audit found on **Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2)**, worst finding first:

---

## Finding 1 — Misattributed source (detach)
**"Minnesota State Census, 1885"** — This record does not belong to Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2). The indexed person was born in 1852 (vs. 1875 on the profile), resided in Aurdal, Otter Tail in 1885 with a wife named Bergit and a son Nils — none of which match. The same record is already attached to **KD96-WX7** (Christian Hole, b. 1852, d. 1919 Aurdal), where it fits perfectly.

> **Action:** Detach this source from KD96-TV2. It belongs to KD96-WX7.

---

## Finding 2 — Indexing error (keep attached, correct the index)
**"Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002"** — The indexed death year is **1954**, but the profile records **1945**. Everything else fits: Erskine, Polk, Minnesota; birth in Norway ~1875; name. This is consistent with a transcription error in the index.

> **Action:** Re-read the original death certificate to confirm, then submit a correction through FamilySearch's correction path on the index entry. Do not detach — the source belongs here.

---

## Checked and agreeing
- **"United States Census, 1900"** — Household (Inger, Ole C.), Fairview Township, and birth year (indexed 1877 vs. 1875) all agree within normal census variance. No issue.

---

## Could not check
- **Uploaded memory (funeral card)** — No readable record ARK; image cannot be read remotely. Its title refers to a 1945 funeral card, which may help corroborate the correct death year once examined alongside the death certificate.

---

## Profile-level notes (not source errors, but worth noting)
- The marriage has **no tagged sources**.
- A **marriage place is missing a city**.
- Multiple residences and places have FamilySearch's non-standard place warning.

---

## Source Audit — 2 Findings

### Finding 1 · Indexing Error
**"Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002"**

The indexed death year is **1954**, but the profile records **1945**. Everything else fits — the name, Erskine, Polk County, Minnesota, and birth 1875 in Norway. This is an index-only collection (no image), so the error is in the index itself.

**Action:** Check the underlying Minnesota death certificate for the actual year of death, then correct the index entry. Keep the source attached — it is otherwise good evidence.

---

### Finding 2 · Misattribution
**"Minnesota State Census, 1885"**

This record does **not** belong to Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2). The record shows:
- Birth: **1852** in Norway
- Residence: **Aurdal, Otter Tail County** (not Polk County)
- Wife: **Bergit** (born 1856)
- Son: **Nils** (born 1879)

Christian P. Hole's profile records birth 1875, residence in Fairview/Polk County, wife Inger, and child Ole C. — none of these match. The record does fit **KD96-WX7** (another Christian Hole, born 1852, Aurdal, Otter Tail, died 1919).

**Action:** Detach this source from KD96-TV2. It belongs to KD96-WX7.

---

### Not a Finding
**"United States Census, 1900"** — The birth year shows 1877 vs. the profile's 1875, but that is normal census-age drift. The Fairview Township residence and household (Inger, Ole C.) fit correctly.

### Could Not Check
**Uploaded funeral card/family photograph** — no indexed record to audit.

---

### Additional Notes (FamilySearch Suggestions)
- The marriage has no tagged sources.
- A marriage place is missing a city.
- One place field is not linked to a standard place.

The audit has been logged to your project's research log as **log_001**.

Here is what the source-evaluation agent found for **Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2)**:

---

## Sources Reviewed: 4 attached, 2 findings

---

### 1. ⚠️ Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002 — Indexing Error
**Link:** https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-002

The index records a death date of **10 June 1954**, but the profile shows **10 June 1945**. Everything else matches (name, birth year 1875, Norway birthplace, Erskine, Polk, Minnesota). This looks like a single bad field in the index — the death *year* is wrong — rather than a different person.

**Next step:** Pull the original Minnesota death certificate. If it says 1945, correct the index entry via FamilySearch's correction path. If it says 1954, the profile's death date needs updating. Keep this source attached in the meantime.

---

### 2. ❌ Minnesota State Census, 1885 — Misattributed
**Link:** https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-003

This record shows a Christian Hole born **1852** in Norway, with wife Bergit and son Nils — but the profile's Christian P. Hole was born **1875**, which would make him only 10 years old in 1885. The 1885 family doesn't match.

This record is already attached to **KD96-WX7** (Christian Hole, b. 1852, d. 1919 in Otter Tail), where it fits exactly.

**Next step:** **Detach this source from KD96-TV2.** It belongs to KD96-WX7, not to Christian P. Hole.

---

### Not a Problem (Noted Only)
- The **1900 US Census** gives birth year 1877 vs. the profile's 1875 — normal census variance, not flagged.
- A **family photograph/funeral card** (uploaded memory) could not be checked for record contents, but its citation does note 1945 for the funeral — worth comparing against finding #1.

---

### Gaps Noted (Not Errors)
- The **1 May 1898 marriage** has no attached sources.
- The marriage place is missing a city.

---

**Summary of actions needed:**
1. Check the original death certificate to resolve the 1945 vs. 1954 discrepancy.
2. Detach the 1885 Minnesota State Census from KD96-TV2 — it belongs to KD96-WX7.

Here is the source-evaluation report for **Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2)**:

---

## Sources on Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2) — 4 attached, 2 findings

---

### 1. Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002 — **Indexing Error**
[https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-002](https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-002)

The indexed death year is **1954**, but the profile records **1945**. The day, month, name, place (Erskine, Polk, Minnesota), and birth year (1875) all match — only the year differs. This single-field discrepancy points to a transcription/index error rather than a genuine conflict.

**Action:** Consult the original death certificate or use FamilySearch's index correction path to fix the indexed year. Keep the source attached.

---

### 2. Minnesota State Census, 1885 — **Misattributed (Wrong Person)**
[https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-003](https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-003)

This record shows a Christian Hole born **1852 in Norway**, residing in **Aurdal, Otter Tail County**, with wife **Bergit** and son **Nils**. Christian P. Hole was born **1875**, lived in **Polk County**, with wife **Inger** and son **Ole C. Hole** — multiple fields disagree. Moreover, this record is already attached to a different person (KD96-WX7, Christian Hole, born 1852, Aurdal, Otter Tail, died 1919), whose facts do fit.

**Action:** **Detach this source** from Christian P. Hole. It belongs to the other Christian Hole (KD96-WX7).

---

### Note on the 1900 Census (not a finding)
The 1900 census ([HOLE-001](https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-001)) shows a birth year of 1877 vs. the profile's 1875. That is ordinary census variance. The residence (Fairview, Polk), wife Inger, and son Ole C. Hole all agree — this source is appropriately attached.

---

### Note on Uploaded Memory (Funeral Card)
A contributor-uploaded photograph/funeral card citing a 1945 funeral card could not be verified from a readable record ID. It corroborates neither a date nor other facts independently.

---

### Impossible-Date Warnings on the Tree
Two warnings were also flagged:
- **Contradiction:** A Residence event dated 1950 appears more than one year after the recorded death of 10 June 1945.
- **Implausible:** A place on this person is not linked to a standard/normalized place.

---

### Additional Profile Suggestions (from FamilySearch)
- The **marriage has no tagged sources**.
- A **marriage place** is missing a city.

---

**Summary:** Detach the 1885 Minnesota State Census (it's the wrong Christian Hole), and correct the indexed death year in the Death Index. The 1950 Residence event likely also needs to be reviewed given the 1945 death date.

### 🔴 Finding 1: Indexing Error — Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002
**Record:** [Minnesota Death Index](https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-002)

The index records a death date of **10 June 1954**, but the profile shows **10 June 1945**. All other details match — place (Erskine, Polk, Minnesota), day and month, and birth year 1875 — so the record belongs to this person. The year field is a transcription error in the index (this collection has no image).

**Action:** Consult the underlying death certificate or state death register to confirm the correct year, then correct the indexed value. **Keep the source attached.**

---

### 🔴 Finding 2: Misattributed — Minnesota State Census, 1885
**Record:** [Minnesota State Census, 1885](https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-003)

This record should **not** be attached to this person. The indexed household is in Aurdal, Otter Tail, with Christian born **1852 in Norway**, wife Bergit, and son Nils. The profile shows birth **1875**, residence in Polk County from 1900, and wife Inger — a 23-year birth year gap, a different wife, and in 1885 Christian P. Hole would have been only 10 years old, not an adult head of household.

This record is already attached to **Christian Hole (KD96-WX7)**, born 1852 in Norway, died 1919 in Aurdal — a much better fit.

**Action:** Detach this source from Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2). It belongs to KD96-WX7.

---

Residence in Fairview, Polk, Minnesota, with wife Inger and son Ole C. The birth year of 1877 is ordinary census rounding variance — not flagged as an error.

---

### ⚠️ Could Not Check: Hole Family Photograph and Funeral Card (uploaded memory)
No readable record ID. The uploader's caption says 1945, matching the profile, but this is the uploader's wording, not independent evidence.

---

### FamilySearch Profile Suggestions (not errors)
- A **marriage place** is missing a city.
- The **marriage has no tagged sources**.

### 🔴 Finding 1 — Indexing Error (Possible)
**Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002**

**Minnesota State Census, 1885**

- Birth: **1852** (profile says 1875 — a 23-year gap, not census drift)
- Wife: **Bergit** (profile says Inger)
- Son: **Nils** (profile says Ole C.)
- County: **Otter Tail** (profile is in Polk County)

**Hole family photograph and funeral card (uploaded memory)** — a contributor upload. Its 1945 date may simply be copied from the tree and cannot independently corroborate either death-year value.

---

1. **Detach** the 1885 Minnesota State Census — it belongs to a different family.
